description: Online/CLI crypto helpers: factor integers, identify and break classical ciphers, run Sage.

tools.name: FactorDB
tools.desc: Look up a known factorization of an integer (RSA modulus n) before trying to factor it

tools.name: Alpertron ECM
tools.desc: In-browser integer factorization (ECM + SIQS) with step-by-step, good for mid-size n

tools.name: YAFU
tools.desc: CLI: automated factoring (trial, Pollard, ECM, SIQS/NFS) picking the best method per size

tools.name: RsaCtfTool
tools.desc: CLI: throws every known RSA attack (Wiener, Hastad, common-factor, Fermat) at a key

tools.name: dCode
tools.desc: Cipher identifier + solvers for classical ciphers, encodings and math puzzles

tools.name: quipqiup
tools.desc: Fast automated solver for monoalphabetic substitution ciphers / cryptograms

tools.name: CyberChef
tools.desc: Browser workbench: chain encodings, XOR, classical ciphers, hashes as a recipe

tools.name: SageMath Cell
tools.desc: Run Sage in the browser: discrete log, elliptic curves, lattices (LLL), modular math

tools.name: WolframAlpha
tools.desc: Compute engine for ad-hoc number theory: modular inverse, CRT, factoring, equations
